# Mahjong tile faces

The SVG files in this directory are the **Regular** (face-up) tile faces from
[FluffyStuff/riichi-mahjong-tiles](https://github.com/FluffyStuff/riichi-mahjong-tiles),
downloaded from
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FluffyStuff/riichi-mahjong-tiles/master/Regular/`.

34 files are used: `Pin1`–`Pin9`, `Sou1`–`Sou9`, `Man1`–`Man9`, `Ton`, `Nan`,
`Shaa`, `Pei`, `Chun`, `Hatsu`, `Haku`. The `-Dora` variants are not used.
